title: Undertow and Postcards
author: Rosalind Eastwick
blurb: Paloma Eriksen, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
